worst_player.name: Senne Lammens
worst_player.why: Lowest BBC user rating on the pitch (2.91) and BBC journalist mark 3. Saved Suárez's 30' penalty, then conceded the second penalty (booked 31') which Suárez scored at 33', and dropped the cross that led to the 80' equaliser. The two shots that followed his errors were worth 1.25 xG. ESPN's shot-stopping model still credits him with +0.69 goals prevented (2 saves, xGOT faced 2.69) because of the penalty save: the problem was the errors, not the saves.

referee_context.fact: Two United goals were not given: Diallo's (~40') because referee Szymon Marciniak blew for a Tielemans foul before the ball went in, so VAR could not intervene; and Kaique's own goal (~82') ruled out after a VAR review for a Dorgu foul on the keeper. Tielemans' first yellow came from the 40' decision; he was sent off with a second yellow at 90'+3'.

caveats: No official player ratings. Best/worst use BBC Sport user ratings (averages of BBC users; the page notes the score is final only after rating closes, so values may move slightly) and BBC journalist marks (United only). Credit 'BBC Sport' on screen.
Possession disagrees slightly (ESPN 51/49, BBC 50.8/49.2): not used.
Full-match United xG: ESPN team stat and BBC 1.07; shot-map sum 1.08 (rounding). Use 1.07 for the full match; half splits from the shot map (0.12 + 0.96).
Fernandes xG: ESPN player stats 0.87 vs shot-map sum 0.88. Player card uses 0.87.
Second penalty: ESPN shot map 33' (kick), BBC key events 31' (foul). BBC says 75 seconds / 1 minute 14 seconds between the save and the foul: conflicting, do not put a seconds figure on screen.
Own-goal minute: ESPN commentary 82' (goal) and 84' (disallowed after VAR), BBC 82'. Don't put a minute on screen for it.
Lammens' 80' error: ESPN says he failed to gather the cross 'under pressure from Suarez' and United wanted a free-kick; BBC calls it 'a routine cross'. Say 'dropped the cross', not 'unchallenged'.
The 1.25 xG 'after Lammens errors' is the xG of the 33' penalty plus the 80' shot (Scout calc from the ESPN shot map); it is not an official stat.
shots_espn.json missed shot 18 (Irankunda 90'+5', 0.02 xG, off target); analysis.py adds it from the cached ESPN page.
BBC Opta 'Total yellow cards 2/1' conflicts with the line-ups (Lammens 31', Tielemans two yellows): card counts not used.

Firecrawl for data/analysis: ESPN team-stats scrape (1), BBC search (2), BBC general live page (1), BBC match page (1) = 5 credits; ESPN match page, player stats, report and commentary were free local fetches. No further research needed for the analysis.
